description: This Java class implements a registry for message mappers, providing methods to retrieve, validate, and manage default, custom, and fallback message mappers within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity mapping service.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperRegistry
classes.description: A final class implementing MessageMapperRegistry that manages default, custom, and fallback message mappers, providing methods for retrieval, validation, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of DefaultMessageMapperRegistry with specified default, custom, and fallback mappers.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Returns a list of message mappers corresponding to the provided PayloadMapping.

methods.name: resolveMessageMapper
methods.description: Resolves and returns a MessageMapper based on a string identifier, checking custom, fallback, and default mappers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on default, custom, and fallback mappers.

methods.name: validatePayloadMapping
methods.description: Validates all mappings in a PayloadMapping, ensuring each can be resolved to a MessageMapper.

methods.name: validateMessageMapper
methods.description: Validates a single mapper string, throwing an exception if it cannot be resolved.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the mappers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the registry, including its mappers.
